task.title: A Labels resource for the Projects API
behaviours: POST /v1/labels with a valid body returns 201, the created label and a Location header pointing at it.
POST /v1/labels with an invalid name or color returns 422 application/problem+json naming each failing field.
POST /v1/labels repeated with the same Idempotency-Key and body replays the first response and creates no second label.
GET /v1/labels is cursor-paginated: following nextCursor visits every label exactly once.
GET /v1/labels/{labelId} returns the label; an unknown id returns 404 and a malformed id 422, both application/problem+json.
All existing tests keep passing and the public contract only gains routes and properties.
task.change:
Add a Labels resource in its own module (src/modules/labels), registered on the app next
to the projects routes, following the API's existing conventions exactly:

1. POST /v1/labels creates a label { name, color }: name 1-40 characters, color a hex
   string like "#1a2b3c". It answers 201 with the label (id, name, color, createdAt) and a
   Location header, honours the Idempotency-Key header like the projects routes, and
   answers 422 application/problem+json for an invalid body.
2. GET /v1/labels lists labels with cursor pagination (cursor + limit, response
   { data, nextCursor }), like GET /v1/projects.
3. GET /v1/labels/{labelId} returns one label, 404 application/problem+json when it does
   not exist, 422 for a malformed id.

The store is in memory, like the projects store. No existing route changes.
